messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Runtime alert (INC-2026-339) - sustained queue length on runtime-prod-eu with rising 503/504s. auto-page oncall.
oncall-lee: oncall here, ack. pulling traces and request heatmap.
nikhil: heap: nodes 7/12 showing in-flight > 300, queue growth primarily on chat-stream and multi-turn rerank. p99 latency ~3.8s, errors trending.
ana: noticing lots of long polls from mobile clients hitting streaming connection keepalive; may be holding slots.
paul: can we toggle streaming -> chunked-delivery disabled for free tier to free up inflight slots? that should free slot-per-connection pressure.
oncall-lee: yes. mitigation plan: 1) reduce max_in_flight on shared pool 2) enable admission-control soft-fail for free tier 3) turn off streaming chunked for free 4) shorten timeouts and enable prioritized queue. applying step 1 now.
nikhil: running: ```rbctl runtime set-config --env=prod --pool=shared --max_in_flight=140 --grace=200ms```
infra-bot: applied runtime config change r-8021 to runtime-prod-eu pool. rolling 10% every 5s.
ops-ivy: starting step 2, admission control: accept up to 10% overflow then soft-fail. command: ```rbctl admission update --scope=free --mode=soft --overflow=0.10```
infra-bot: admission config updated, policy active.
paul: step 3: feature-flagging streaming for free tier: ```ffctl set streaming --scope=free --state=off --reason=\"inc-2026-339\"```
ops-ivy: FF change pushed. backend shows feature flag evals returning false for free.
nana: within 40s connections drop, inflight slots reclaimed. good sign.
nikhil: step 4: adjusting timeout profile for best-effort routes: ```rbctl runtime set-config --env=prod --route=best-effort --timeout_ms=3000 --early_fail_threshold_ms=1200```
oncall-lee: also enabling prioritized queueing by SLA: high/normal/low where low gets rate-limited aggressively. command: ```rbctl queue set-priority --pool=shared --tiers=high,normal,low --low-share=0.15```
infra-bot: queue priority update applied r-8022.
paul: continuing: edge rate-limit bump for free: ```edgectl quota update free --rps=2 --burst=4``` to stop noisy clients from surge.
customer-svc: reached out to a couple of customers seeing retries; opened CH-1445 for impacted free accounts. enterprise unaffected (on dedicated).
nikhil: metrics 60s post-change: inflight median reduced 320->110, queue length halved, 503/504s down 73%. p99 dropped to 1.4s.
oncall-lee: good. one follow-up: some paid small customers on shared pool saw degraded tail. scheduling limited rollback of streaming flag for paid-tiers only. ffctl: ```ffctl set streaming --scope=paid --state=on```
ops-ivy: re-enabled streaming for paid, no config churn.
nana: logs show a subset of older SDKs not handling early-fail gracefully -> clients retry aggressively. we should add graceful fast-fail header so SDKs can backoff: `X-RW-FastFail: 1`.
paul: prep quick support note for SDK teams. also recommend stateless retries at client side.
nikhil: switching shedding mode to score-based by age to clear stuck long polls: ```rbctl runtime set-shedding --mode=score --score=connection_age```
infra-bot: shedding mode update r-8023 rolled to 100%.
ops-ivy: observed stabilization: errors down to 0.9%, overall throughput -10% but SLA customers stable.
noncall-lee: documenting mitigation steps in incident chat for morning handoff at 08:00 UTC. items: verify r-8021/22/23 completed, monitor p95/p99, confirm SDK header rollout, follow CH-1445.
nikhil: leaving a note to add a permanent mitigation: admission-control per-tenant + streaming slot accounting in next sprint.
customer-svc: posting a short status update to #status: \"Partial service disruption for free-tier streaming; mitigations in place. Dedicated and paid customers unaffected.\" link https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2026-339
incident-bot: INC-2026-339 -> mitigated (monitor). auto-paging suspended, awaiting postmortem if persistent.
oncall-lee: thanks team. will handoff to morning oncall @jordan. closing thread but will watch for 30m.
paul: :thumbsup: nice quick coordination.
